title: Outside wall penetrations.
officialText:
Where vents, including those for direct-vent appliances, penetrate outside walls of buildings, the
annular spaces around such penetrations shall be permanently sealed using approved materials to prevent entry of combustion
products into the building.
SECTION FGC 504
SIZING OF CATEGORY I
APPLIANCE VENTING SYSTEMS
